SLAYTHEREQUIEM-EBB_STONES_EVENT.title: Six Stones by the Water
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-EBB_STONES_EVENT.pages.IN: Six stones lie in the shallows, humming with the ebb. Three of them are within reach. A shard taken now will last until the end of the act.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-EBB_STONES_EVENT.pages.TA: The stone is warm in your hand. The tide will take it back when the act ends.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-EBB_STONES_EVENT.pages.LE: You walk away. The stones keep humming.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHRINE_EVENT.title: Shrine
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHRINE_EVENT.pages.INITIA: A quiet shrine of one of the Celestials. A priest tends the candles and sells relics of the god's set: an Amulet for 120 gold and a Robe for 150.
You already carry this god's blessing.
The Celestials do not answer the Apostate.
Donate [gold]{Cost}[/gold] gold: righteousness +1 step (once per act).
Requires [gold]{Cost}[/gold] gold; once per act; impossible for the Outcast's chosen.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHRINE_EVENT.pages.BLESSE: Warmth spreads through you. Anything else?
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHRINE_EVENT.pages.REDEEM: The priest nods. A weight lifts from your soul.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHRINE_EVENT.pages.BOUGHT: The priest wraps the relic in clean linen.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHRINE_EVENT.pages.ROBBED: You run, the offering bowl clinking. Somewhere a candle goes out.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DARK_SHRINE_EVENT.title: Dark Shrine
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DARK_SHRINE_EVENT.pages.I: An altar of black stone. Two Princes of the Abyss offer their gifts — each with a Price. A pact makes you Apostate — unless an Ashborn accepts a gift of the Tribunal.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DARK_SHRINE_EVENT.pages.A: The pact is sealed. The Prince is watching.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BEAST_BLOOD_EVENT.title: Beast Blood
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BEAST_BLOOD_EVENT.pages.I: A wounded wolf the size of a horse watches you from the brush. Its eyes are almost human.
Your current form or worldview forbids it.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BEAST_BLOOD_EVENT.pages.A: The fever passes by dawn. Something else stays.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-URN_WHISPER_EVENT.title: Whisper from the Urn
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-URN_WHISPER_EVENT.pages.I: An urn of black clay whispers your name and offers a pact: power over the dead for a piece of your life.
Your current form or worldview forbids it.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-URN_WHISPER_EVENT.pages.A: The whisper falls silent. Your heart beats a little slower.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-VIGIL_EVENT.title: Vigil
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-VIGIL_EVENT.pages.INITIAL: An empty chapel with one candle still burning. A night of prayer here could change you.
Your current form or worldview forbids it.
Only the Righteous may keep this vigil.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-VIGIL_EVENT.pages.ACCEPTE: At dawn the candle is still burning. So are you.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DEEP_HEART_EVENT.title: Heart of the Deep
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DEEP_HEART_EVENT.pages.IN: A dwarven automaton lies broken in the dark, its clockwork core still ticking.
Your current form or worldview forbids it.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CRYPT_FEAST_EVENT.title: Feast in the Crypt
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CRYPT_FEAST_EVENT.pages.I: Pale nobles feast in a crypt and invite you to their table. The wine is very red.
Your current form or worldview forbids it.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CRYPT_FEAST_EVENT.pages.A: You wake in a coffin. You are no longer cold.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-PHYLACTERY_EVENT.title: Phylactery
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-PHYLACTERY_EVENT.pages.IN: A soul jar on an altar of bone. A Herald could finish the rite here.
Your current form or worldview forbids it.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-PHYLACTERY_EVENT.pages.AC: Your heart stops. You do not.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DARK_SHRINE_EVENT.pages.I: An Ordinator serves only the Tribunal.
